out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed in walk in cooler raw minced pork being stored above RTE vegetables and RAW fish being stored above RTE dumplings
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge agreed to rearrange walk in, will follow up in 3 days to verify compliance

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: garlic, flour, rice, msg, salt, sugar
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. person in charge agreed to make labels for food

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food stored on the floor of walk in cooler/ walk in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge agreed to move food off the floor of the walk in cooler

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: @TABLEWARE@ were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. Person in charge moved utensils so they are no longer lip contacting surfaces facing upward

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of @FOOD@. Garlic containers/ fruit juice bottles were being re-used for ingredient storage
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Person in charge agreed to discontinue use of manufacturer containers

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. Observed dish machine was operating at 10 ppm for bleach based sanitizer
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. Pic primed dish machine so it reached 50ppm minimum stated on data plate

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: @TABLEWARE@, @EQUIPMENT@. Observed inside walls and shelves of walk inc oiler were not clean to sight and touch
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Person in charge agreed to clean WIC YU NOODLES (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: PIC did not have read agreed and signed copies of EH policy available at the establishment during inspection
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS provided PCI a copy of policy. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: EHS observed raw tilapia being stored in such a manner it could contaminate cooked shrimp and over steam pork and chicken dumplings.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC moved the raw tilapia so it was being stored under the cooked shrimp and cooked pork and chicken dumplings.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: EHS observed the front door of the establishment was open for ventilation without effective barrier against pests during the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means EHS had PIC close the front door during the inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: EHS observed the an incorrect Chlorine test kit (POOL designation kit) being used for chemical sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: PIC agreed to obtain a bleach test kit for a restaurant establishment. EHS will verify compliance in 10 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Utility Lines/Pipes, Not Exposed
violations.observation: EHS observed the access panel for the utility pipes and cooling system above the WALK IN COOLER being kept open.
violations.corrective_action: Utility line and pipes cannot be unnecessarily exposed on a wall or ceiling. PIC agreed to close access panel.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO HAND SOAP IN DISPENSER AT KITCHEN HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM PROVIDED HAND SOAP.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AND PORK ON BOTTOM SHELF OF WIC UNDER RAW FISH AND PORK.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. -CFM HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE COOKED FOODS TO TOP SHELF

violations.title: Food Contact with Equipment & Utensils
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found stored in contact with soiled equipment or utensils: OBSERVED PORTIONED UNCOOKED NOODLES IN PLASTIC BOWLS STACKED ON TOP OF ONE ANOTHER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized or the food shall be in contact with only single-service items. EHS RECOMMENDED SEPARATING PORTIONED NOODLE BOWLS WITH PLASTIC WRAP OR ALUMINUM FOIL. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE SEPARATE BOWLS WITH PLASTIC WRAP.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRESH GARLIC IN OIL MIXTURE OBSERVED AT 73F ON PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS REVIEWED OPTIONS OF USING TPHC OR COLD HOLDING MIXTURE. CFM WILL KEEP MIXTURE UNDER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED BOILED PORK DUMPLINGS COOLING IN CONTAINER WITH LID ON ON PREP TOP. OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AND PORK IN WIC COOLING WITH LIDS ON.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS REVIEWED PROPER COOLING PROCEDURES WITH CFM. CFM REMOVED LIDS TO FACILITATE FASTER COOLING.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: OBSERVED BULK CONTAINER OF RICE STORED ON PREP TABLE SHELF NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, AND NEXT TO BOX OF CLEANING PRODUCTS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. EHS RECOMMENDED MOVING BULK CONTAINER OF RICE TO AN AREA OF KITCHEN WITH OTHER FOOD STORAGE. STORAGE NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND CLEANING PRODUCTS IS NOT ADVISED.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED SCOOP AND SPOON USED FOR SMOOTHIES IN CONTAINER OF SOILED WATER ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM EMPTIED CONTAINER OF SOILED WATER AND HAD CONTAINER AND UTENSILS WASH, RINSE AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. CFM COULD NOT LOCATE BLEACH TEST STRIPS.
violations.corrective_action: CFM ORDERED BLEACH TEST KIT DURING INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED TEST STRIPS TO CFM. YU NOODLES (Inspection Date: 11/22/2024) Page 2 of 3
